There are a total of 27 apprenticeship vacancies, including 15 in the Administration unit and 12 in the Technical unit. Candidates applying for the Administration unit must be graduates in any discipline, while those applying for the Technical unit must hold a degree in Engineering or Technology. Candidates who completed their qualifying degree in 2022 or thereafter are eligible to apply. Applicants who have already undergone or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act elsewhere will not be eligible, and their candidature will not be considered.
